items.headline: Alibaba releases Qwen3-VL vision-language model
items.summary: Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B (Instruct and Thinking) is an open-weight vision-language model with 256K native context, GUI agent abilities, 32-language OCR and visual coding; Qwen calls it the most capable VL model in the series. Smaller sizes followed in October 2025.
